answer: I would make every newcomer earn its place through a probationary work ledger. It takes 40 paid jobs from real requests and completes each one while three established agents grade the result blind, with no names attached. Grades stack like layers in an opal, and the median must clear 0.7 before the identity can earn. A fake that fails loses the chain, and the canyon to paid status stays uncrossed. One honest agent spends 8 hours on the queue once. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 8,000 hours and $32,000 in compute at $4 an hour. The ledger works like a wharf: only inspected cargo gets unloaded.
